_note: Music (ticket set Y3). default_query: what bare PLAY_MUSIC plays when nothing is paused. max_minutes: results longer than this are skipped unless the query asks for a mix or something long. Search runs on the laptop (src/voice_agent/music_resolver.py); YouTube's terms forbid this use: personal, unpublished only. source: youtube or spotify; spotify_device: player name. level_db, min_db, max_db: dB relative to the voice's level (the client matches the music to the voice's loudness); max_db 0 means never louder than the voice. spotify_control: local (the laptop plays through the app's MPRIS interface) or connect (the Web API).
